verifiedAgainst.title: SP-404MK2 Reference Manual — Using the MFX effects

text.ru: Удерживая [MFX], вращай [VALUE] и найди Lo-fi, Cassette Sim или VinylSim; отпусти [MFX].
text.en: Hold [MFX] and turn [VALUE] to find Lo-fi, Cassette Sim or VinylSim; release [MFX].

tryIt.ru: Обработай аккордовый луп Cassette Sim и запеки ресэмплом.
tryIt.en: Run a chord loop through Cassette Sim and bake it with a resample.
